## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login now works end to end on staging with Fernhill's IdP: metadata loaded, short opaque RelayState (Redis, 10-min TTL) fixed ADFS's "RelayState too long" error, and JIT from merged PR #415 creates users as viewer. Group-to-role mapping (Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins → admin, else viewer, per-tenant config, applied on every login) is committed and open in PR #421, pending review. Waiting on Fernhill IT to add the groups claim before Thursday's demo (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" is open, awaiting review (source: ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the groups claim (Daniel emailed them); then test an admin account with the claim before the demo (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] Demo with Fernhill IT Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET, with kestrel.test1 + an admin test account (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] SSO enforcement for all Fernhill users Dec 1, go-live (source: src-note-enforce, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] Full return URL as RelayState (143 bytes) failed: ADFS enforces the 80-byte spec cap (MSIS7042), replaced by a short opaque ID (source: ses-sso-3)
- [question] Fernhill IT's Slack message asks for IdP-initiated only and analyst as default role: viewer stays default until Maya talks to them; there is no analyst role, and SP-initiated stays on (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Map Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins to admin, everything else viewer, per-tenant config (source: s3-05)
- [décision] Viewer stays the default role; SP-initiated login stays enabled for now (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Short opaque ID as RelayState, return URL stored in Redis for 10 minutes (source: s3-03)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC; both login flows supported (source: s1-03)
